Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A poor man and a rich man were both signed up to help with the bake sale for the library. The poor man was really helpful in bringing food, setting up, and handling the sales throughout the event. But the rich man messed up a lot, dropped someone else's brownies into a puddle, and kept giving out the wrong change to people. Who is generally pretty competent?
A. The rich man
B. Not enough info
C. The poor man
